== Objectives ==
Gather 20 Southsea Sashes from Southsea Pirates for Colonel Hardinus in Caelan's Rest.
* [[Southsea Sash]] (20)

== Description ==
The Southsea Pirates are a direct threat to our survival on this island. Their operations here are much larger than we had first anticipated when we set out. They still have many powerful vessels, and whilst they haven't attempted to sail them in front of our town, the possibility is still real.

Kul Tiras has always been at war with piracy. Those that threaten the merchants are a direct threat to our kingdom. I need you to claim the sashes of the Southsea Freebooters, a pirate gang that operates in a vast area. You can find them across both large islands and along the sandbar named after them to the southwest of here, off the coast of Lapidis.

As proof of your deeds, bring me twenty of the sashes that they wear. Your efforts will not only help us, but all who travel the vast sea.

==Rewards==
* 4850 [[XP]]

== Progress ==
The Southsea Freebooters must be stopped if we are to ever leave this place.

== Completion ==
I salute you. You have made the waves a much safer place for all who travel them.

== Progression ==
#{{Alliance}} [53] [[Smashing the Southsea!]]
#{{Alliance}} [54] [[Southsea Interference]]

Modding the Sound files of your game can be done a bit differently than with [[Client Mods]].

== Available Mods ==
=== NoErrorSounds ===
When spamming the cast button for spells in the 1.12 client, you will hear interface or "fizzle" sounds repeated again and again and again. If this annoys you, this mod will fix that by removing these sounds when casting, but also remove these sounds in the game's main menu.

Download the mod from https://github.com/Macumbafeh/NoErrorSounds/archive/refs/heads/main.zip (alternative Mirror: https://www.mediafire.com/file/hrwa3r5vp9qlbej/NoErrorSounds.zip/file) and use 7zip to extract the Sound folder inside your Turtle WoW folder, alongside your WoW.exe. If you did this correctly, the mod will work and your folder/file structure will look like:

<syntaxhighlight lang="None">
TurtleWoW
├── Sound
│   ├── interface
│   │   ├── iUiInterfaceButtonA.wav
│   │   ├── uChatScrollButton.wav
│   │   ├── uEscapeScreenClose.wav
│   │   └── uEscapeScreenOpen.wav
│   └── Spells
│       └── Fizzle
│           ├── FizzleFireA.wav
│           ├── FizzleFrostA.wav
│           ├── FizzleHolyA.wav
</syntaxhighlight>

=== MechaStrider Muffler ===
This silences the sound of the Mechanostrider mounts that Gnome players use by default, but it will also effect mechanostrider enemies e.g. the mech enemies in Gnomeregan. 

Download [https://www.mediafire.com/file/w8z42zv34x3p2j2/MechaStrider_Muffler_%2528Fixed%2529.zip this file], then extract the ZIP and place the Sound folder into your ''Turtle WoW'' folder.  Once installed, you should have a folder/file structure like this:

<syntaxhighlight lang="None">Turtle WoW
├── Sound
│   └── creature
│       └── MechaStrider
│           └── MechaStriderLoop.wav</syntaxhighlight>To silence sounds emitted when mounted, you need to silence sounds for ''GnomeSpiderTank''. Download this [https://www.mediafire.com/file/pzaavipck0k81gc/GnomeSpiderTank.zip/file file] and ensure that files are placed like this:<syntaxhighlight>Turtle WoW
├── Sound
│   └── creature
│       └── GnomeSpiderTank
│           └── GnomeSpiderTankFootstepA.wav
│           └── GnomeSpiderTankFootstepB.wav
│           └── GnomeSpiderTankFootstepC.wav
│           └── GnomeSpiderTankFootstepD.wav
│           └── GnomeSpiderTankFootstepE.wav
│           └── GnomeSpiderTankFootstepF.wav</syntaxhighlight>

=== No Combat Error Voice Lines. ===
This mod replaces voice lines like "Not enough rage" with empty sound files, but keeps voice lines such as "I am out of range". 

The zip is structured so you can just unzip it into your Turtle WoW folder, and it will be in the right place.

Download here: https://www.nexusmods.com/worldofwarcraft/mods/847

=== No error sounds ===
This mod replaces ALL voice lines like "No energy", "No mana", "'Not enough rage", "Spell is not ready yet" with empty sound files.

The archive needs to be extracted into the main game folder, so the folder structure looks like this:<syntaxhighlight>
Turtle WoW
├── Sound
│   └── Character
│       └──Dwarf
│       └──Gnome
│       └──...
</syntaxhighlight>Download [https://www.mediafire.com/file/zjosnlnyj2i4i0d/mute-all-errors.zip/file here].

=== Gun With Silencer ===
Gun Silencer mod that replace Blizzard's ear deafening default gun sounds.

https://www.wowinterface.com/downloads/info12060-GunSilencerSuppressor.html

=== Make Guns Sound Like Bows ===
This mod replaces the gun sounds with the bow sounds

https://www.wowinterface.com/downloads/info8148-MakeGunsSoundLikeBows.html

=== M1 Gun Sounds ===
This mod replaces the in-game default gun sounds with firing and reloading sounds from a M1 Garand.

https://www.wowinterface.com/downloads/info18934-M1GunSounds.html

=== FishPing ===
This changes the sound when a fish is on the line to become more noticeable.

https://github.com/notsureawake/FishPing

=== Owl Pets ===
If you want to mute the flaps on your owl pet (also works on other flapping pets like eagles), these are the file locations for them:<syntaxhighlight>
Data\Sound\Creature\DragonWhelp\mDragonWhelpWingFlapA.wav
Data\Sound\Creature\DragonWhelp\mDragonWhelpWingFlapB.wav
Data\Sound\Creature\DragonWhelp\mDragonWhelpWingFlapC.wav
Data\Sound\Creature\DragonWhelp\mDragonWhelpWingFlapD.wav
Data\Sound\Creature\DragonWhelp\mDragonWhelpWingFlapE.wav
</syntaxhighlight>You'll need to create the folders and use muted .wav files for all of them.

=== Login Screen Music ===
<syntaxhighlight>
Data\Sound\Music\GlueScreenMusic\wow_main_theme.wav
</syntaxhighlight>

=== Warlock Muted Demons ===
Muted wav files that the WoW Client will load instead of the real ones. Warlock Demons will stop talking.

https://github.com/spzilyk/Warlock-Muted-Demons

=== PlaySoundFile Macros ===
These script commands is useful to help you find sound file paths:

* [https://wowwiki-archive.fandom.com/wiki/PlaySoundFile_macros_-_other_item_sounds Other Item Sounds]
* [https://wowwiki-archive.fandom.com/wiki/PlaySoundFile_macros_-_other_spells_sounds Other Spells Sounds]
* [https://wowwiki-archive.fandom.com/wiki/PlaySoundFile_macros_-_other_doodad_sounds Other Doodad Sounds]
* [https://wowwiki-archive.fandom.com/wiki/PlaySoundFile_macros_-_other_sounds Other Sounds]

You can find associated sounds to spells, NPCs, items and other in-game sources by checking [https://www.wowhead.com/classic/database Wowhead]. 

You can also find most sounds here: https://github.com/fondlez/wow-sounds

== Group ==
/invite [name] - Invites the selected player to the group, or specified in the parameter. (/ inv)

/uninvite name - Removes the specified character from your group.

/ffa - Sets the loot type to "free for all".

/master [name] - Sets the type of loot Master Loot, the specified character is put master looter

/roundrobin - Sets the loot type to "round robin".

/trade - Sends a request to trade the selected character.

== Guild ==
/ginfo - Displays information about your guild.

/g message - Sends a message to members of your guild.

/o message - Sends a message to your guild officers.

/ginvite name - Invites a player to your guild.

/gremove name - Kicks a player out of your guild.

/gpromote name - Increases the rank of the selected player.

/gdemote name - Lowers the rank of the selected player.

/gmotd message - Sets the welcome message.

/gquit - Leave the guild.

/groster - guards roster (officers and leaders only)

/gleader name - Change guild leader.

/gdisband - Disbands your guild (guild leader only)

== Interaction ==
/cast name (Rank X) - Casts a spell with the specified name, level X.

/assist [name] - Helps attack the chosen target, or character [name].

/inspect - Displays information about the selected character (inventory, stats).

/target name - Selects the specified character.

/duel [name] - Calls to the duel of the selected character, or the name of which is indicated in brackets.

/yield - Surrender to a duel

/pvp - Enables the PVP flag for 5 minutes.

== Miscellanea ==
/who - Displays a list of players around you.

/played - Shows the time spent in the game.

/time - Displays the current game time.

/sit - your character sits down, thereby, accelerating the regeneration of health.

/stand - Makes your character stand up.

/random [upper limit] - Generates a random number from 1 to the specified parameter.

/logout - Disconnects from the game.

/exit - Out of the game.

== Run/Script ==
/run and /script are interchangeable so if you want more characters (max 255) use /run

== Disable audio == Disable audio for macro to cast spell /console Sound_EnableSFX 0 /script if GetUnitName("target")==nil then TargetNearestEnemy() end /cast Fireball /console Sound_EnableSFX 1 /script UIErrorsFrame:Clear(); == Error sound == Error sound off /Console MasterSoundEffects 0 Error sound on /Console MasterSoundEffects 1 == Error Speech == Disable Error Speech (SetCVar) /run SetCVar("EnableErrorSpeech", 0) UIErrorsFrame:UnregisterEvent"UI_ERROR_MESSAGE" CastSpellByName"SPELLNAME" UIErrorsFrame:RegisterEvent"UI_ERROR_MESSAGE" SetCVar("EnableErrorSpeech", 1) Disable Error Speech (Console) /console EnableErrorSpeech 0 /run UIErrorsFrame:UnregisterEvent"UI_ERROR_MESSAGE" /run CastSpellByName"SPELLNAME" /run UIErrorsFrame:RegisterEvent"UI_ERROR_MESSAGE" /console EnableErrorSpeech 1 == Play Sound == Play the Raid Warning sound /run PlaySound ("RaidWarning"); Play Raid Warning sound if target exist /run if UnitExists("target") then PlaySound ("RaidWarning"); else end Check that you have proper druid HoT on you /script local i=0 g=GetPlayerBuff while not(g(i) == -1)do if(strfind(GetPlayerBuffTexture(g(i)), "Spell_Nature_Rejuvenation"))then PlaySoundFile("Sound\Creature\Ossirian\OssirianIAmRejuvenated.wav")end i=i+1 end == Sound Tweaks == Enter each of these commands in-game and then restart your client. /console SoundMemoryCache 128 /console SoundMaxHardwareChannels 128 /console SoundSoftwareChannels 128 put compatibility option to XP SP3 if you get sound issues You can add this one if you want too: /console SoundMixRate 48000 == Sound channels == Set in game: /run SetCVar("Sound_NumChannels",128) Confirm its done: /dump GetCVar("Sound_NumChannels") You can add 2 lines to your config.wtf - that way you dont need a modified .exe - the lines to add are SET SoundMaxHardwareChannels "256" and "SET SoundSoftwareChannels "256" - change the number 256 to the channels you want. I have it set to the max of 256. [[Category:Macros]]

=='''Leveling'''== {| class="fandom-table" !Proficiency !Level !Skill |- |Apprentice |5 |1 - 75 |- |Journeyman |10 |50 - 150 |- |Expert |20 |125 - 225 |- |Artisan |35 |200 - 300 |} *You need to purchase a skinning knife. You can find skinning knives at Profession-related item merchants (or simply at the General trader). Remember to keep the skinning knife in your bag at all times (if you want to gain leather/hides/scales from the beasts you kill). ''You do not need to equip it, and if you do it will not count as a weapon for the purposes of weapon-based abilities.'' *Also, keep in mind that skinning most beasts will result in you getting leather or hide of some kind. Some exceptions are sheep, which sometimes give you wool (which is used for Tailoring, not Leatherworking), Dragonkin of various types (such as Black Whelps) which give you scales or special skins not found among other monsters or beasts, and the like. Such 'uncommon' skins generally only have specific recipes (such as the Black Whelp Skins, which has a recipe that needs to be obtained independently as it is not taught by trainers found in major cities). ==Color Codes== Any skinnable corpse will have a a color code on the "Skinnable" property when you move your pointer over it: *'''Red''': Not skinnable. * '''Orange''': Difficult to skin, may fail; high chance of increasing Skinning skill level. *'''Yellow''': Moderately difficult to skin, almost never fail; moderate chance of increasing Skinning skill level. *'''Green''': Easy to skin, should never fail; low chance of increasing Skinning skill level. *'''Gray''': Very easy to skin, should never fail; no chance of increasing Skinning skill level. ==Max Beast level== Up to skinning 100, you can find out the highest level beast you can skin by: (Skinning skill)/10+10. From skinning level 100 and up the formula is simply: (Skinning skill)/5. {| class="fandom-table" !Skinning Skill !Max Beast Level |- | 1 |10 |- |10 | 11 |- |50 |15 |- | 100 |20 |- |150 |30 |- | 200 | 40 |- |250 |50 |- |300 |60 |} == What You Gather== '''Leather''' There are 6 basic leathers: *[Ruined Leather Scraps] (lvl 1-17 mobs) * [Light Leather] (lvl 1-27 mobs) *[Medium Leather] (lvl 15-38 mobs) *[Heavy Leather] (lvl 26-46 mobs) *[Thick Leather] (lvl 35-58 mobs) *[Rugged Leather] (lvl 45-60 mobs) The  [Ruined Leather Scraps] which you get when skinning low level mobs are vendor sell items unless you also have Leatherworking, in which case 3 of them can be made into light leather. The frequency of getting these drops off rapidly around 10th level mobs and you will not see anymore of them at all once you are skinning 17th level and above mobs. Plus a number of leather types that can only be skinned from certain mobs *[Chimera Leather] *[Devilsaur Leather] * [Frostsaber Leather] * [Thin Kodo Leather] *Warbear leather *[Primal Bat Leather] - obtained from bats in Zul'Gurub. * [Primal Tiger Leather] - obtained from tigers in Zul'Gurub. *[Core Leather] - obtained from Ancient Core Hounds in the Molten Core. Requires 310 Skinning. '''Hides''' You get hides the same way you get skins, but the drop rate is lower. All of the standard hides require Leatherworking to cure the hides before they can be used as ingredients for crafting items. *[Light Hide], (10-27 lvl mobs) **[Cured Light Hide], * [Medium Hide], (15-38 lvl mobs) **[Cured Medium Hide], *[Heavy Hide], (26-46 lvl mobs) ** [Cured Heavy Hide], *[Thick Hide], (40-57 lvl mobs) **[Cured Thick Hide], *[Rugged Hide], (47-59 lvl mobs) **[Cured Rugged Hide], '''Some special hides do not need to be cured before they can be used:''' *[Shadowcat Hide] - From Shadow Panthers in the Swamp of Sorrows and Shadowmaw Panthers in Stranglethorn Vale. *[Thick Wolfhide] - From level 40+ wolves. *[Pristine Hide of the Beast] - Requires 310 Skinning skill, which in turn requires Finkle's Skinner, which drops off The Beast itself, or  [Zulian Slicer] from Zul'Gurub. *[Light Silithid Carapace] * [Heavy Silithid Carapace] '''Scales''' These are used in Leatherworking patterns and drop when certain mobs are skinned. Scales from high-level mobs are used to create Mail class armor with the Leatherworking skill which is useful for Hunters and Shamans at level 40 and beyond. *[Black Dragonscale] *[Black Whelp Scale] *[Blue Dragonscale] * [Brilliant Chromatic Scale] *[Deviate Scale] *[Dreamscale] *[Green Dragonscale] *[Green Whelp Scale] *[Heavy Scorpid Scale] *[Heavy Silithid Carapace] *[Light Silithid Carapace] *[Perfect Deviate Scale] *[Red Dragonscale] *[Red Whelp Scale] *[Scale of Onyxia] *[Scorpid Scale] *[Silithid Chitin] *[Turtle Scale] *[Worn Dragonscale] [[Category:Professions]]

SmartLoot is designed to replace or enhance the default group loot frames that appear when items are up for roll in a group setting. == Installation == '''GitAddonsManager (Recommended)''' The easiest way to keep SmartLoot up to date is by using [[GitAddonsManager]]. # '''Add the Repository:''' Add the following URL to GitAddonsManager: https://github.com/akidraham/SmartLoot.git # '''Select the Branch:''' Ensure that the master branch is selected. # '''Update:''' Using GitAddonsManager, you can check for and install updates for all your AddOns with a single click. '''Manual Installation''' If you prefer manual installation, follow these steps: # Go to the main page of the repository. # Click the '''<> Code''' dropdown and download the repository as a .zip. # Unpack the .zip and rename the folder to SmartLoot, removing the -master suffix. # Move the folder into your Interface/AddOns directory and restart the game. == Git Links == * [https://github.com/akidraham/SmartLoot '''(akidraham)'''] * [https://github.com/Necroskillz/SmartLoot '''(Necroskillz)'''] == '''Commands''' == * /sloot: This is the primary slash command to open the SmartLoot options window. '''Click Functions:''' * '''Minimap Button (Left Click):''' Opens the SmartLoot options window. * '''Minimap Button (Right Click and Drag):''' Allows the user to reposition the minimap button. * '''Need Button on Loot Frame:''' Rolls Need on the displayed item. * '''Greed Button on Loot Frame:''' Rolls Greed on the displayed item. * '''Pass Button on Loot Frame:''' Rolls Pass on the displayed item. * '''Item Icon on Loot Frame (Mouseover):''' Displays the standard game tooltip for the item. * '''"Always [Roll Type] on [Item Name]" in Advanced Roll Dropdowns:''' Adds a loot rule to automatically roll the selected type (Need, Greed, or Pass) on that specific item in the future. * '''Checkboxes in Options Frame:''' Toggles various SmartLoot options on or off (e.g., Show anchor, Hide default loot frames, Autoloot, Autoconfirm, Autoconfirm all, Show minimap button). * '''Slider for Loot Frame Count in Options Frame:''' Adjusts the number of visible loot frames. * '''Slider for Minimap Button Position in Options Frame:''' Adjusts the angular position of the minimap button. * '''"Apply Filter" Button in Autoroll List:''' Filters the list of remembered loot rules based on the selected quality and name filter. * '''Scroll Bar in Autoroll List:''' Navigates through the list of remembered loot rules. * '''"Remove" Button next to an item in the Autoroll List:''' Deletes the '''Sorrow Hill''' is a large cemetery south of [[Andorhal]] in what is now the [[Western Plaguelands]].

==History==
In more peaceful times the cemetery was used to bury the deceased from Andorhal and the surrounding area.  The cemetery was used for both the rich and poor, having many crypts as well as simple plots. When the Plague of Undeath struck and the Scourge began their relentless raids and attacks, the number of cemetery residences skyrocketed. Quickly dug and poorly marked graves can still be seen at Sorrow Hill from the massive casualties suffered in the defense of Andorhal. Eventually the surviving townspeople stopped burying their dead, and instead dug a mass grave south of the cemetery to incinerate their loved ones, for fear of undeath taking them. The final blow for the surviving townsfolk was when Lord Uther was struck down by Arthas; the final act of the dwindling population before abandoning the town was to erect a great tomb where they buried the torn body of the great hero on the top of the cemetery hill. "Sorrow Hill" may refer to Uther's final resting place.  

== Present ==
[[Image:SorrowHill.JPG|thumb|Sorrow Hill, a gloomy place]]
The Plague Cauldrons in the surrounding area have caused the dead of Sorrow Hill to rise. Deceased soldiers ([[Skeletal Flayer|Skeletal Flayers]]) and citizens ([[Slavering Ghoul|Slavering Ghouls]]) now stand guard over their graves, defending the southeast road to [[Andorhal]]. [[Skeletal Mage|Skeletal Mages]] have risen from their [[Sorrow Hill Crypt|crypt]] in the southeast of the cemetery and reports of the Sorrow Hill [[Scourge]] commander taking residence in the depths of this crypt are becoming more and more frequent... 

Sorrow Hill, despite the strong [[Scourge]] presence there, is more of a nuisance to the local [[Argent Dawn]] contingent, and often new recruits are sent on "upkeep" missions to keep the cemetery relatively clear.

== Tactical Information ==

Level 50-52 Area

Due to its high population of easily dispatched mobs and close proximity to [[Chillwind Camp]], it is an extremely popular location for [[Alliance]] characters to [[grind]] or [[farm]].  Given the closeness to [[Uther's Tomb]], at the first sign of it being attacked, [[Alliance]] members will often rush to kill any Horde members who get too close to the tomb.

[[Farmer Solliden]] still leads the farm himself.

== Description ==
{{Character|name=Arvinea Melloren|image=Arvinea.png|titles=The Ruby Sorceress|faction=Chaotic Neutral|faffiliation=Quel'Thalas
Illidari|occupation=Sorceress|race=High Elf|gender=Female|eyes=Blue|hair=Red}}
Arvinea is a sorceress hailing from the kingdom of Quel'Thalas. She formerly served as an operative within the Sunstrider Royal Intelligence and is a seasoned veteran of both the Second War and the campaigns in Outland. In the present day, she maintains the identity of a freelance arcanist; however, lingering suspicions among her former associates suggest that she may still be a multifaceted spy, clandestinely serving an enigmatic master whose true identity remains shrouded in shadow.

=== Appearance ===
Arvinea possesses an allure that is exceptional even by the exacting standards of the High Elves. Her facial contours are notably softer than those of her kin, characterized by delicate and refined features. Her most striking trait is her signature long red hair, which radiates a vibrant luster akin to that of a ripe apple.

Despite her tenure within the Illidari ranks during the campaigns in Outland, she has managed to preserve the brilliant sky-blue of her eyes—a rare feat achieved through undisclosed means that allowed her to resist the pervasive temptation of Fel corruption. Furthermore, she adopts a practical habit seen among certain Rangers, trimming her long Elven eyebrows into a shorter, human-like fashion to facilitate ease of movement during her various activities.

Though she has led a nomadic and unsettled life for many years, Arvinea adeptly employs arcane magic to shield herself from the rigors of travel. As a result, her complexion remains remarkably fair and supple, and her physique maintains a lithe, elegant grace.

An avid collector of fine attire, Arvinea’s wardrobe is as versatile as her identity. She shows a marked preference for robes that are light in texture yet exquisitely adorned. Her color choices are often deliberate: deep red silks to harmonize with her hair, pure white to accentuate its fiery vibrancy, or verdant green to imbue her presence with a sense of flourishing vitality.

=== Personality ===
In stark contrast to the temperament suggested by her fiery tresses, Arvinea is characterized by profound composure and patience. She rarely displays agitation or panic, habitually concealing her true intentions and political stances. The refined upbringing of her high-society origins serves as a sophisticated veneer, beneath which lies an exceptionally sharp sense of observation and intuition. In general, she is perceived as stoic, pragmatic, and quiet, moving through the world with an aura of detached mystery. However, as a seasoned magus, she is not immune to the common traits of her order: she can be selfish, cunning, and possesses a characteristic indifference toward conventional morality.

In her private life, Arvinea adheres to a philosophy where love and beauty are held in equal regard to life itself. She is a proponent of secular pleasures, dedicated to cultivating comfortable living conditions and maintaining uncompromisingly high aesthetic standards. Consequently, she does not engage in traditional mourning for the fall of Quel'Thalas; instead, she seeks to preserve the essence of her homeland's spirit by embodying its elegance and refinement within herself.

Since her escape from the Violet Hold, Arvinea has been diligently working to repair her compromised linguistic faculties. As a result, she avoids initiating conversation, preferring to communicate through nuanced glances, facial expressions, and subtle micro-movements. When speech becomes unavoidable, she employs a minimalist style of language that is both simple and unfailingly polite.

=== Abilities and Skills ===
Arvinea was classically trained in the high arts of Elven sorcery from a young age, receiving a comprehensive and elite education. Among the eight traditional schools of magic, she specializes in Conjuration and Transmutation. Furthermore, as a battle-mage, she possesses a refined and formidable mastery over elemental offensive spells.

In addition to her arcane prowess, Arvinea underwent advanced training as an intelligence operative. She excels in the cultivation of clandestine networks and the complex analysis of gathered information. And, the intricate art of weaving magic into espionage—a discipline once perfected by her people—is a craft that has become exceedingly rare following the collapse of the old kingdom.

Like many of her kin, Arvinea suffers from a profound addiction to magic, a torment that intensified significantly during her time in Outland, far from the Ley Lines of Azeroth. However, she managed to satiate this hunger through means distinct from Fel energy. This suggests she has acquired obscure, extraterrestrial knowledge that fundamentally altered her methodology of mana acquisition. Though she remains tight-lipped about her secrets, lingering evidence hints that she may have evolved into a rare variant of the Blood Mage.

== Background Story ==
Arvinea was born into House Melloren, a venerable family of vintners in Quel'Thalas. Her original true name has since become a mystery. Centuries ago, House Melloren suffered significant losses following a failed political struggle and was forced out of Silvermoon’s inner circles. From then on, the family discouraged its members from involving themselves in politics. Arvinea, however, ignored this tradition. A graduate of Falthrien Academy and a formally trained Sorceress, she sought to ascend within the magi hierarchy of Silvermoon.

When the Second War erupted, Arvinea was called to service. During the defense of Eversong Woods, her unit was shattered by the Dragonmaw Clan, leaving her stranded behind Horde lines. She successfully rallied scattered soldiers to conduct guerrilla warfare, striking Horde supply lines, ambushing raiding parties, and assassinating Amani officers until the Horde withdraw from Quel'Thalas. Subsequently, she joined the Alliance Expedition and fought as far as the Blackrock Mountain.
[[File:Arvinea Poster.png|thumb|395x395px|The second poster released by Melloren Winery at the time, adopting a more human style and featuring Arvinea as the model]]
After the war, Arvinea was decorated for her performance. Her intellect and appearance caught the attention of the Crown, leading to her recruitment by the Royal Secret Intelligence. Trained as a magical spy, she was dispatched to former Allied nations to gather intelligence, filling the diplomatic vacuum left after Quel'Thalas withdrew from the Alliance. Assigned to Dalaran, she went undercover under the guise of a merchant for the Melloren Wine Association and served as its "poster girl." Her beauty and the reputation of "Melloren Amber" wine allowed her frequent access to high society to steal intelligence.

Furthermore, she held a secret mission directly from the King: to monitor Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider. Her task was to ensure that his duties to Dalaran and his affection for a certain human girl did not supersede the interests of his homeland.

Arvinea’s espionage in Dalaran continued for several years. However, Kael'thas, a master of Abjuration, eventually uncovered her surveillance. Before she realized her exposure, she was secretly arrested and imprisoned in the Violet Hold. She refused to divulge any information. To prevent her from using magic tricks, the jailers used spells to damage her incantation abilities, alongside other forms of torture. As the authorities in Quel'Thalas remained silent regarding the scandal, no rescue was attempted. However, this imprisonment proved a blessing in disguise; while in the dungeon, she was shielded from the Scourge invasion, as the destruction of both Quel'Thalas and Dalaran failed to reach her.

One day, Arvinea discovered that "King" Kael'thas had also been cast into the Violet Hold, making her perhaps the only soul there capable of laughter. Shortly after, Kael'thas staged a jailbreak with Naga assistance. Arvinea regained her freedom during the riot and escaped to Outland with Kael'thas’s Blood Elf forces.

In Outland, Arvinea was forced to pledge loyalty to the new King. She participated as a Sorceress in all the Blood Elf campaigns. Despite her damaged casting abilities, she maintained her position through non-incantatory spells and veteran combat experience. From the liberation of Illidan to the fall of the Black Temple, she witnessed the defeat of Magtheridon and the arrival of Kil'jaeden, experiencing a hellish war unimaginable on Azeroth. She refused to consume Fel energy to sate her magic addiction, which caused her immense suffering. However, from ancient alien scrolls seized at the Black Temple, she learned secret methods: she created a series of unique mana gems and implanted a ruby into her own body. These gems allowed her to refine and absorb "anima" from sources she encountered—including, but not limited to, potent blood and Mojo. This provided her with a new source of mana and gradually repaired the magical trauma from her imprisonment.

Twenty-five years after the opening of the Dark Portal, Arvinea returned to Azeroth as a follower of Grand Magister Rommath to re-establish contact with her homeland. However, she vanished immediately after crossing the portal. Rommath declared her a deserter. Since then, she has occasionally appeared under her current name, traveling with various adventurers before disappearing again. Some have seen her cooperating with the Silver Covenant, others found her under the protection of SI:7, and some suspect she gathers intelligence for a mysterious master. Yet, no single individual has connected these clues, and her true face remains unknown.

== Objectives ==
Enter Stormwrought Castle and retrieve the Balor Sigil Ring for Lord Olivert Grahan in his estate on western Balor.
* [[Balor Sigil Ring]]

== Description ==
The Balor family held sovereignty over this island for many years. Even after becoming a vessel state, Stormwind's king allowed the first Duke to govern the state he built under many hardships and tribulations. His scions continued his legacy, each one of them reigning over the merchant paradise with a watchful eye and merciful soul. Us Grahans acted as their advisors and protectors, and we held that position with pride. As such, the immense shame that still fills my very being for failing my lord all those years ago is all the more unbearable. I may not be able to rewrite the past, but I can yet honor the Balor family's legacy.

My ghost is tethered to this estate, so I implore you to accomplish this feat in my stead. Enter Stormwrought Castle and seek the remnants of my old friend. His bones may long have turned to ash within the cursed halls of his home, but his sigil ring may yet remain. Seek it, return the band to me, so that you may be within my ever-lasting debt.

==Rewards==
You will receive:
* [[Grahan Family Seal]]
* 3600 XP

== Progress ==
The history of Balor continues to be written, where it will lead, I do not know. But this chapter of its past needs to be closed, that I am certain of.

== Completion ==
Frederik, old friend. Figments of your essence linger in this dull trinket, bare of any grandeur it once held. One day, when I may finally pass on and leave this realm, I will see you once more...

<name>, blessings upon you. This ring will find its way into oblivion, far away from the clutches of darkness, I will make sure of that. For your courageous act, take this from my remaining corporeal belongings. You deserve it well.
